optical_sar_confidence_investigation.root_cause: In optical_sar mode, task_classifier added 'vqa', causing select_tools_for_tasks to append 'rs_vqa'. Since rs_vqa lacked an optical_sar runner, orchestrator fell back to mock_specialists._make_vqa_result which contained a legacy 0.72 placeholder.
optical_sar_confidence_investigation.resolution:
1. Restricted optical_sar tool planning so optical_sar_analyzer acts as the sole primary specialist covering VQA, captioning, and change detection on multi-sensor pairs without calling single-image rs_vqa.
2. In orchestrator.py, set agg_conf = None whenever real specialists run or whenever mode is optical_sar or bi_temporal.
3. Updated mock_specialists.py to enforce confidence=None for optical_sar and bi_temporal mock fallbacks.
optical_sar_confidence_investigation.verified_output: Case C confidence is now strictly null (None).

change_detection_metrics_separation.isolation_guarantee: Benchmark metrics are strictly stored in offline evaluation reports and never injected into per-inference confidence or live reasoning prompts.

scientific_claim_audit.findings: Zero hyperbolic or unsupported claims found in production UI or backend endpoints.
scientific_claim_audit.canonical_positioning: SatQuery-AI accepts heterogeneous satellite imagery, validates compatibility, adapts supported inputs, and routes imagery to specialist models with documented validated domains. Unsupported imagery is explicitly flagged rather than producing misleading predictions.

limitations: Spatial overlap between Image A and Image B is 0.0% (images cover non-overlapping geographic regions).
Spatial non-overlap: change detection cannot produce meaningful comparative results between two completely different geographic locations.
Bi-temporal change detection specialist currently does not support SAR-only or mixed SAR-Optical change detection.

answers_to_mandatory_questions.Q1_is_any_uncalibrated_value_presented_a: NO — All specialist inference paths (Change Detection, Change VQA, SmolVLM VQA, Optical+SAR fusion) strictly return confidence=null. Mock placeholder values are suppressed whenever real or multi-sensor analysis executes.
answers_to_mandatory_questions.Q2_is_optical_sar_confidence_genuinely_c: NO — The Optical+SAR gated dual-branch fusion baseline is an exploratory architecture and does not possess a temperature-calibrated posterior probability estimator. Its confidence is strictly reported as null (None), and its 0.72 leak was eliminated.
answers_to_mandatory_questions.Q3_does_change_detection_expose_only_leg: YES — The Siamese U-Net exposes only legitimate detector telemetry: threshold (0.70), changed_pixel_pct, changed_pixel_count, total_pixel_count, severity, and processing time. Benchmark metrics (IoU, F1) remain strictly quarantined in offline logs.
answers_to_mandatory_questions.Q4_can_unsupported_imagery_accidentally_: NO — Non-overlapping pairs, SAR-only bi-temporal inputs, and out-of-domain queries trigger the Change Detection Domain Gate which returns UNSUPPORTED_FOR_RELIABLE_INFERENCE, suppresses change masks (change_map=None), and returns structured limitations without fabricated answers.
answers_to_mandatory_questions.Q5_are_all_public_claims_scientifically_: YES — All claims of 'universal model', '100% accurate', or 'works on all satellites' have been audited and replaced. SatQuery-AI is explicitly documented as a routing and adaptation architecture with specialist models bounded to specific validated domains.
